Sources of the tables

Source: R/data-sources.R
data_sources.Rd

data_sources() lists the source of each table of locationchoicedatajp: one row per getter, with its publisher, terms of use, and a line of attribution. data_attribution() gives the lines of attribution of the getters used, to credit the sources in publications.

Usage

data_sources()

data_attribution(functions = NULL)

Arguments

functions

Names of getters, such as "land_price_get", or NULL (the default) for all of them.

Value

data_sources() returns a tibble with one row per getter: function_name, source_name, publisher, source_url, license_name, license_note, license_url, and attribution.

data_attribution() returns a character vector of the distinct lines of attribution of functions.

Details

The terms of National Land Numerical Information are those of ksjdata (ksjdata::ksj_available), so they follow its catalog; they differ by release for some datasets (for example, 地価公示 is CC BY 4.0 from 2019 and 商用可 before). The terms of e-Stat and of the Statistics Bureau are compatible with CC BY 4.0.

Every source asks for credit, and data that are processed must say so. The tables of locationchoicedatajp are processed (reshaped, renamed, and converted), so the lines say that they were processed (加工して作成). Complying with the terms is up to you; this package does not give legal advice.
